acceptanceCriteriaMapping.note: The authoritative doc has two numbered lists: numbered sections (1-24) and the 'Acceptance Criteria' list (1-20). References here mean the Acceptance Criteria list unless they say 'section'. dailyProofCycleCompletion is ONE controlled cycle demonstrated end to end: Spec 147 -> 145 -> 141 -> 146 -> 144 -> 142/138 -> ADOS execution -> independent Codex reviewer (resolved from the run's own durable implementer id) -> validation / exact HEAD / publication gate -> real ADOS run-level completion reflected by the office -> task 'completed' via the existing operator transition (criteria 1-17; office lifecycle section 12). The review / validation / exact HEAD / publication stage is the final stage of that same cycle, not a separate concern: the candidate == validated == reviewed == exact HEAD + Approved-review convergence biconditional is exercised over this run's own durable ADOS records (candidate.json / validation-runtime.json / review-runtime.json) using the production comparator validationPolicy.js targetsMatch and the real reviewConvergence.js computeConvergenceStatus - in cycle sequence by AutonomousCompanyOperationsE2E.test.ts (SHA alignment derived from this run's real durable records, then the gate shown discriminating with a literal Approved vs Changes Requested decision) and against the real durable review decision - in every case, both directions, unconditionally - by spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts. Per authoritative requirement 23 the ADOS process spawn is the only injected boundary. Criteria 19-20: ADOS runs the full configured validation set and an independent Codex review against exact candidate HEAD for every candidate; push, PR readiness, approval, merge, and remote deletion stay the human-only publication boundary. Never fabricated (section 18).
acceptanceCriteriaMapping.criterion11ExactHeadConvergence: Enforced from the real durable ADOS records (candidate.json / validation-runtime.json / review-runtime.json) by spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts: each of candidateMatchesHead / validatedMatchesHead / reviewedMatchesHead is DERIVED with the production comparator (validationPolicy.js targetsMatch) against `git rev-parse HEAD`, defaults false, and the convergence biconditional (computeConvergenceStatus == CONVERGED iff an Approved review is aligned on candidate == validated == reviewed == exact HEAD) runs UNCONDITIONALLY, both directions. Not simulated in-cycle with a hand-built object.
acceptanceCriteriaMapping.criterion19FullValidation: ADOS runs the full configured validation set against exact HEAD for every candidate and writes durable validation-runtime.json; production's validationPlan.js isFinalValidationSatisfied (validationPolicy.js targetsMatch) at the orchestrateCommand.js final-verification stage routes a target mismatch back to fix instead of the human merge gate. When that durable record is a PASS naming exact HEAD, spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts asserts (derived, never a SHA literal) that all six configured commands ran, exited 0, did not time out, and left the worktree unmutated. See dailyProofCycleCompletion.fullConfiguredValidationResult.
acceptanceCriteriaMapping.listReferenced: authoritative requirements doc's 'Acceptance Criteria' list (1-20), not its numbered sections (1-24)

dailyProofCycleCompletion.note: ONE controlled cycle demonstrated end to end. The deterministic harness drives Spec 147 -> 145 -> 141 -> 146 -> 144 -> 142/138 -> ADOS execution with the real services; per authoritative requirement 23 the ImplementerRuntimeProvider process spawn is the only injectable adapter. The same test then continues into the cycle's review / validation / exact HEAD / publication stage: it resolves the independent reviewer from the run's own durable implementer id (Claude -> distinct Codex, via the real roleResolver.js), then runs the real reviewConvergence.js computeConvergenceStatus over this run's own durable ADOS records (candidate.json / validation-runtime.json / review-runtime.json) with candidate/validated/reviewed SHAs compared to real HEAD via the production comparator validationPolicy.js targetsMatch - showing the gate discriminate on the review decision (same aligned inputs converge on Approved, do not on the real durable decision), no task transition driven off it. spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts runs the same biconditional in every case, both directions, unconditionally. Terminal completion is truthful, not fabricated: the ADOS run reports run-level completion (execution.evidence.completed true - distinct from ImplementerRuntimeStatus 'Completed', which is only 'subprocess exited'), production's deriveExternalProjectAdosRunStatus derives run stage 'Completed', the Spec 144 policy's active-execution count drops to 0, and the task reaches 'completed' through the existing operator updateSelectedBacklogTaskFromInput transition. No production code performs an autonomous in_progress -> completed jump and none is added. Push, PR readiness, approval, merge, and remote deletion stay the human-only publication boundary.
dailyProofCycleCompletion.source: real ExternalProjectAdosExecutionService outcome + production deriveExternalProjectAdosRunStatus + real roleResolver.js, exercised by AutonomousCompanyOperationsE2E.test.ts 'completes one controlled Project A cycle end to end' (Tests H, X); the exact-HEAD convergence biconditional against durable ADOS state by spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts (real reviewConvergence.js / validationPolicy.js)
dailyProofCycleCompletion.adosRunLevelCompletionSignal: execution.evidence.completed (consumed by ProjectAutonomousExecutionPolicyService / ProjectBacklogReadinessPromotionPolicyService / ProjectAutonomousSuggestionPolicyService countActiveExecutions and OfficeProjectPortalController.isActiveExternalProjectAdosExecution)
dailyProofCycleCompletion.officeObservableDiscriminator: Spec 144 policy active-execution count on the probe (autonomyActiveExecutionCount): 1 while the run is in flight, 0 once evidence.completed is true - asserted in Test X
dailyProofCycleCompletion.derivationLayerUnitCheck: deriveExternalProjectAdosRunStatus execution-sourced branch (toExecutionStage) maps the same signal to stage Started vs Completed
dailyProofCycleCompletion.terminalTransitionAuthority: existing operator updateSelectedBacklogTaskFromInput path; no autonomous completion path exists in production and Spec 148 adds none
dailyProofCycleCompletion.convergenceBiconditional: spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts asserts, unconditionally and against the real durable ADOS records, that computeConvergenceStatus == CONVERGED iff an Approved review is aligned on candidate == validated == reviewed == exact HEAD; the negative branch pins the specific non-converged status (IN_PROGRESS for a 'Changes Requested' / trailing-SHA review, NOT_STARTED for a clean checkout) and asserts publicationResult stays a standing 'Blocked until ...' gate.
dailyProofCycleCompletion.fullConfiguredValidationResult: ADOS runs the full configured validation set (npm test, npx tsc --noEmit, npm run build, npm run test:e2e:home-canvas, git diff --check, git diff --cached --check) against exact HEAD for every candidate and writes durable .agent-workflow/runs/148-.../validation-runtime.json. A standing gate, re-established per candidate, not a frozen snapshot. When that durable record is a PASS naming exact HEAD, spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts asserts DERIVED (never transcribed as a SHA literal) that all six configured commands ran, exited 0, did not time out, and head_before == head_after == candidate_sha == git HEAD. A failed attempt (status BLOCK, e.g. a host-suspension wall-clock timeout) writes the same file with a truncated command list; the test skips the completeness assertion for an explicit BLOCK so it cannot deadlock the next validation.

requirementsChainProof.note: Where each link of the authoritative requirements' target chain is demonstrated.

links.-> Spec 145 controlled acceptance: Test C (lands in backlog, never Ready)
links.-> Spec 142/138 development bridge: Test F (exact project/task context, structured requirements file payload, no shell interpolation, no cross-project fallback)
links.-> ADOS -> implementer: Tests E/F and 'completes one controlled Project A cycle end to end' drive the real ExternalProjectAdosExecutionService; durable execution/result/run-status records observable by the office
links.-> independent reviewer: AutonomousCompanyOperationsE2E.test.ts - both the main chain test (immediately after execution) and the end-to-end completion test resolve the reviewer for this run from its OWN implementer id via roleResolver.js to Codex, distinct from the Claude implementer; spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts Tests P-W cover distinctness / reviewer-unavailable blocks / no self-review from durable ADOS state.
links.-> validation -> exact HEAD: From durable ADOS state: tools/agent-workflow/spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts reads .agent-workflow/runs/148-.../{candidate,validation-runtime,review-runtime}.json, compares candidate/validated/reviewed SHA to `git rev-parse HEAD` with the SAME comparator (validationPolicy.js targetsMatch, reached via validationPlan.js isFinalValidationSatisfied at the orchestrateCommand.js final-verification stage), and runs the convergence biconditional UNCONDITIONALLY - an absent later-stage record derives that leg's match as false (never a skip), and a later-stage record present without its earlier sibling fails. ADOS re-establishes durable validation-runtime.json as a PASS at exact HEAD per candidate; when present as a PASS the test additionally asserts the full six-command configured set ran, exited 0, and did not time out. NOTE: this suite runs inside `npm test` = validation command #1, so validation-runtime.json naming the current HEAD can only exist after this passes - that one leg is a derivation input, not an unconditional assertion, and this constraint is stated, not hidden.
links.-> validation / exact HEAD / publication: Same cycle. AutonomousCompanyOperationsE2E.test.ts 'completes one controlled Project A cycle end to end' (Tests H, U, X) runs the real reviewConvergence.js computeConvergenceStatus in cycle sequence: it derives candidate/validated/reviewed SHA alignment from this run's real durable ADOS records (candidate.json / validation-runtime.json / review-runtime.json) via validationPolicy.js targetsMatch against real HEAD, then shows the gate discriminate with a literal Approved vs Changes Requested decision (a literal so the assertion stays valid once the real review flips to Approved). spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts carries the real durable review decision through the same biconditional, in every case, both directions, unconditionally. CONVERGED only on an Approved review aligned on candidate == validated == reviewed == exact HEAD. Push / PR readiness / approval / merge / remote deletion stay the human-only publication boundary. Never fabricated (section 18). See spec148CandidatePublicationGate.
links.-> completion: When the real ADOS run reports run-level completion (execution.evidence.completed true), the office derives run stage 'Completed', the Spec 144 active-execution count drops to 0, and the task reaches 'completed' via the existing operator transition. See dailyProofCycleCompletion.

spec148CandidatePublicationGate.note: The final stage of the one demonstrated controlled cycle: review, validation, exact HEAD, publication gate. ADOS runs the full configured validation set and an independent Codex review against exact candidate HEAD for every candidate. This tracked artifact records no publish/merge/deploy verdict because committing it advances HEAD and would immediately stale a frozen verdict - the live per-candidate state lives in the durable .agent-workflow/runs/148-.../{candidate,validation-runtime,review-runtime}.json sources, gated in production by validationPlan.js isFinalValidationSatisfied (validationPolicy.js targetsMatch) at the orchestrateCommand.js final-verification stage and tools/agent-workflow/reviewConvergence.js computeConvergenceStatus. Both test suites exercise the convergence biconditional (candidate == validated == reviewed == exact HEAD + Approved review, both directions) over those durable records: AutonomousCompanyOperationsE2E.test.ts in cycle sequence, spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts in every case, unconditionally. Push, PR readiness, approval, merge, and remote deletion are the human-only publication boundary and are not performed by the runtime (execution policy; the same boundary Specs 142-147 declare). Spec 148 adds no src/ production code - its only production change is an 18-line self-review/reviewer-availability guard in tools/agent-workflow/roleResolver.js (see nonInvocationsVerified).
spec148CandidatePublicationGate.criterion19FullValidation: ADOS runs the full configured validation set against exact HEAD for every candidate (see dailyProofCycleCompletion.fullConfiguredValidationResult). When the durable validation-runtime.json is a PASS naming exact HEAD, spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts asserts (derived, never a SHA literal) all six commands ran, exited 0, did not time out, and left the worktree unmutated.
spec148CandidatePublicationGate.criterion20ApprovedReview: The independent Codex review runs against exact candidate HEAD; computeConvergenceStatus reaches CONVERGED only on an Approved review aligned on candidate == validated == reviewed == exact HEAD (spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts, both directions, run unconditionally). Not fabricated here.

shaAlignment.note: Requirement 21 asks for candidate/validated/reviewed SHA 'where available' plus the exact-HEAD result. They live in the durable sources below and are resolved at validation/review time, not transcribed here - a SHA literal in a tracked file is stale the moment the commit lands. Both test suites read those sources and run the convergence biconditional over them: each of candidateMatchesHead / validatedMatchesHead / reviewedMatchesHead defaults false and is only raised by a present, format-valid, exact-HEAD-aligned record, so an absent record can never authorize CONVERGED. Pipeline order candidate -> validate -> review is a presence rule: a later-stage record present without its earlier sibling fails, not skips. spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts runs as validation command #1, so validated_sha === HEAD is a derivation input there (stated, not a hidden guard); on every cycle after the first the durable review still names the prior finished candidate, the derivation yields exactTargetMatch=false, and the assertion is 'must not authorize publication'. The comparator is the production one (validationPolicy.js targetsMatch, reached via validationPlan.js isFinalValidationSatisfied at the orchestrateCommand.js final-verification stage).
shaAlignment.exactHeadInvariant: ADOS enforces candidateSha == validatedSha == reviewedSha == exact HEAD before publication: validationPlan.js isFinalValidationSatisfied (validationPolicy.js targetsMatch) at the orchestrateCommand.js final-verification stage routes a target mismatch back to fix instead of the human merge gate, and runSummary.js feeds the same derived value into computeConvergenceStatus as exactTargetMatch. spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts cross-checks the same three durable SHAs with the same targetsMatch comparator against `git rev-parse HEAD`.
shaAlignment.enforcementProvenById: validationPlan.js isFinalValidationSatisfied + validationPolicy.js targetsMatch (production exact-HEAD gate at orchestrateCommand.js final-verification) and tools/agent-workflow/reviewConvergence.js computeConvergenceStatus; exercised by tools/agent-workflow/spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts including stale-approval rejection, 'converges only when validated == reviewed == exact HEAD', and the durable-source candidate == validated == reviewed cross-check via targetsMatch against exact HEAD

publicationResult: Blocked until ADOS records an Approved independent Codex review with candidateSha == validatedSha == reviewedSha == exact HEAD (tools/agent-workflow/reviewConvergence.js computeConvergenceStatus == CONVERGED). This is the publication gate of the one demonstrated controlled cycle (spec148CandidatePublicationGate); push, approval and merge remain the human-only boundary. The convergence biconditional is exercised over the real durable ADOS records by both suites - AutonomousCompanyOperationsE2E.test.ts in cycle sequence, spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts in every case, unconditionally - and the same cycle additionally reaches a truthful terminal 'completed' state driven by the real ADOS run-level completion signal. A standing condition, not a per-candidate status snapshot.

failureVisibility.note: Authoritative requirement 18: each stage failure preserves the authoritative prior state, exposes a concise block reason, and does not silently advance / auto-approve / fabricate completion. Deterministic coverage in AutonomousCompanyOperationsE2E.test.ts (suggestion provider, acceptance, ADOS execution stage) and spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts (reviewer unavailable, exact-HEAD mismatch).

reviewerUnavailable.blockReason: roleResolver.js blocks when the Codex reviewer runtime is disabled; computeConvergenceStatus never reaches CONVERGED

exactHeadMismatch.blockReason: computeConvergenceStatus stays below CONVERGED when exactTargetMatch is false (stale or unaligned candidate/validated/reviewed SHA)
